parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of gender identity or expression; the 'unnatural sex' provision is residual and must be read against the 2007 ruling. No documented police targeting, border friction, facility bans, or trans killings; travel documents come from the visitor's home country, so the patchy domestic LGR machinery is climate only. Documented negatives are societal-tier: discrimination and frequent physical/sexual harassment of visibly trans people in provincial cities, rural violence against residents, growing anti-LGBT political rhetoric including death threats in 2026, and conversion practices. These are tier-3 hostilities with no police-custody or state-enforcement pattern shown. Offsets: third-gender recognition, functioning Supreme Court relief, active civil society, pride events, curriculum inclusion. Trajectory is improving but harassment prevalence and weak recourse hold it at the low end of Reduced Risk.
